title: Planet
blurb: Explore how Earth’s motion and its relationship with the Sun and Moon produce days, seasons, phases and eclipses.

title: Interior & Plates
blurb: Look inside Earth and follow the movement of tectonic plates to understand how oceans open and mountain belts form.

title: Atmosphere
blurb: Investigate how sunlight, air pressure and circulation shape weather and the world’s broad climate patterns.

title: Water & Carbon
blurb: Trace water and carbon through connected stores, then compare the behavior of rivers, oceans and catchments.

title: Landforms
kicker: Read the shape of a landscape
blurb: Examine how rivers, waves, glaciers and rock deformation shape the land around us.

title: Soils & Rocks
kicker: Discover how rocks and soils change
blurb: Inspect rock textures and soil profiles, and compare the processes that break down, transport and transform their material.

title: Hazards
blurb: Explore what drives earthquakes, eruptions, tsunamis and storms, and separate the physical process from its local impacts.

title: Skills
blurb: Build confidence with contours, coordinates and projections by comparing each map with the terrain or globe it represents.
